info.name: ScoreSpace
info.description: A community-first games publisher that helps game jammers turn their submissions into a full-scale title. They published the Discord Blackjack game, which has reached millions of players worldwide!

info.name: BenBonk
info.description: An awesome game development YouTuber with ~80k subscribers. He is the developer of several amazing games including Slimekeep, a rogue-like with many cute and squishy slimes!

info.name: Jerbob
info.description: Jerbob is a super cool game dev YouTuber with ~80k subscribers, and a developer of many fun and goofy games!

info.name: GDC Festival of Gaming
info.description: The global gathering of the game industry, uniting developers and publishers from around the world.
